plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-10 from the official Slippery Rock University 2026-2027 Academic Catalog (catalog.sru.edu). Semester sequence is the catalog's Recommended Four-Year Plan (Plan of Study Grid), printed Total Hours 120; every semester below sums to the grid's printed 15 Hours and the plan to exactly 120 (ESAP 101 FYRST Seminar is printed 0-1 credits and recorded at 0; see its choice_note). The Curriculum Guide summary is Rock Studies 2: 42 + Major Requirements: 36 + Other Requirements: 6 + Electives: 36 = 120. In the guide, four Core Course rows are 'or' pairs (each row 3 credits; the alternative's own hours are not printed separately) and the Depth Experience totals 9 credits across the three Depth slots in the plan (options include PSYC 450 + PSYC 485, PSYC 451 plus 300-400-level PSYC electives, or 9 credits of 300-400-level PSYC electives). The Rock Studies mathematics row in the guide is a 3-credit choice (MATH 117, MATH 125, MATH 210, MATH 225 or STAT 152); the plan grid prints MATH 117 Quantitative Reasoning in First Year Fall and it is recorded as printed. A Psychology BA is also offered and is not collected here. Major GPA 2.0 or higher; overall GPA 2.0 or higher. Students must also pass a DEI-designated course prior to graduation.
